author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In the collection archive of Cinema Relics, Adam encounters some of the surviving miniature Halloweentown sets from Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas! Collector and prop historian Dan Lanigan shows Adam stop-motion puppets from the film, which he's had restored from deterioration and preserved on newly sculpted bases. They take a look at an armature from the Santa puppet to marvel at the complexity of these characters. 

Learn more about Cinema Relics prop investigations at: https://www.youtube.com/@cinemarelics/videos
